text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The municipality of Chitungwiza town, about 40 km south of the Zimbabwe capital Harare, is to spend about Z$100,000 next week on the installation ceremony for recently elected executive mayor Andrew Jiri.

- Acting Zimbabwean public service, labour and social welfare minister Nathan Shamuyarira on Sunday night charged that the three-week strike by junior doctors and nurses to press for better salaries and working conditions had the political motive of confronting the government and the ruling ZANU-PF party.

- Zimbabwe's ministry of Agriculture is issuing wheat permits to producers and approved traders to export up to 50,000 tonnes of wheat this year despite an expected shortfall of about 100,000 tonnes to meet domestic need.
